purpose: Teach: 配線/一周/進め方/納入/現職/心構え/立ち上がる/取り組ま

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 工場の配線、最新化、急げ。
lines.en: Get the plant wiring modernized. Fast.
lines.style: Clipped, direct authority. No softening. Each phrase lands with weight. Quick breath between clauses. Eyes forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、敷地を一周する朝礼、定着しました。
lines.en: Understood. The morning site walk with all staff—it's taken root.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact report. Slight lift of pride on 'taken root.' Professional but not stiff. Meeting his eye level.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プロジェクトの進め方、若手にも教えろ。
lines.en: And teach the younger people how to handle a project from start to finish.
lines.style: Clear instruction, not a suggestion. Measured pace. Slight emphasis on 'teach'—this matters. Firm but not harsh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。納入予定、来月、調整します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll adjust the delivery schedule—we're targeting next month.
lines.style: Efficient, competent. Slight nod of confirmation embedded in the voice. No hesitation. Professional handoff of an understood task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 現職員の声、聞き続けるんだ。
lines.en: Keep listening to what the current staff has to say.
lines.style: Quiet insistence. Not a request. Lean forward slightly in the voice. Conviction underneath the calm surface.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新入社員、心構え、研修で教えます。
lines.en: Yes. We'll cover mindset and how to carry themselves in the new-hire training.
lines.style: Committed clarity. Warm undertone—he takes this responsibility seriously. Measured, confident. No rushed delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新事業、すぐ立ち上がるよう、準備。
lines.en: Have the new division ready to launch immediately.
lines.style: Sharp, final-sounding. Economical. No room for delay. Brief pause weight. Command voice, but not unkind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域社会に取り組ませる、姿勢、貫きます。
lines.en: Understood. We'll hold to our commitment—community engagement isn't a side project.
lines.style: Firm close. Quiet conviction on the last phrase. Shows he's understood not just the task but the principle. Standing height in the voice.
